answer: The yarrow graph is validated at intake and the wharf frontier is published, thus the ancestry of every answer is public, and hollow anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Every submission must name 5 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. Scaling up is where the attack dies: 456 fake identities need 478 separate proofs, each held 48 days, so the bill grows in a straight line while the reward stays flat. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
